text: Kun so'zi: mitigate mitigate (fe'l) — biror narsaning salbiy ta'sirini kamaytirmoq, yumshatmoq. Talaffuz: /ˈmɪtɪɡeɪt/ Misol: Planting more trees can help mitigate the effects of air pollution in big cities. (Ko'proq daraxt ekish katta shaharlarda havo ifloslanishi ta'sirini kamaytirishga yordam beradi.) Qayerda qo'l keladi: Writing Task 2 da ekologiya, sog'liq va transport mavzularida. Ko'pincha shu so'zlar bilan keladi: risk, impact, effects, damage. The new law aims to mitigate the risk of flooding. Yaqin ma'noli so'z: • alleviate — (muammo, og'riqni) yengillatmoq: The new bridge has alleviated traffic congestion. ✍️ Vazifa: "mitigate" bilan o'zingiz uchun 2 ta gap tuzing — biri ekologiya, biri ta'lim mavzusida.

"Impact" so'zi bilan 5 ta tayyor birikma IELTS da so'zni alohida emas, birikma (collocation) sifatida bilish muhim. Bugun — impact (ta'sir). • have an impact on — ...ga ta'sir qilmoq Social media has a huge impact on teenagers. • a significant impact — sezilarli ta'sir The new policy had a significant impact on unemployment. • a negative impact — salbiy ta'sir Fast food has a negative impact on health. • minimise the impact — ta'sirni kamaytirmoq Factories should minimise their impact on the environment. • long-term impact — uzoq muddatli ta'sir The long-term impact of this decision is still unclear. Ko'p uchraydigan xato: impact to ❌ → impact on ✅ ✍️ Vazifa: 3 ta birikmani tanlab, o'zingizning shahringiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing.

Present Perfect yoki Past Simple? Speaking'da eng ko'p uchraydigan grammatik xatolardan biri. Past Simple — aniq vaqtda tugagan ish (yesterday, last year, in 2020): I visited Samarkand last summer. — O'tgan yozda Samarqandga bordim. Present Perfect — vaqt aniq aytilmagan yoki natija hozir muhim (ever, never, already, since, for): I have visited Samarkand three times. — Samarqandga uch marta borganman. I have lived in Tashkent since 2019. — 2019-yildan beri Toshkentda yashayman. Xato: I have visited Samarkand last summer. ❌ "last summer" — aniq vaqt, shuning uchun Past Simple kerak. Maslahat: "Have you ever...?" savoliga Present Perfect bilan javob bering, tafsilotlarni esa Past Simple bilan ayting: Yes, I have. I went there with my family two years ago. ✍️ Vazifa: "Have you ever been abroad?" savoliga shu usulda 2–3 gaplik javob yozing.
topic: Grammatika: Present Perfect va Past Simple

text: Speaking Part 1: "Do you like reading?" Part 1 da ideal javob — 2–4 gap: javob + sabab + kichik tafsilot. Band 7 darajasidagi namuna javob: Yes, I'm quite a keen reader, actually. I mostly read non-fiction, especially books about psychology, because they help me understand people better. These days I don't have as much free time as I'd like, so I usually read for about twenty minutes before bed. Foydali iboralar: • a keen reader — kitob o'qishni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam My sister is a keen reader of detective stories. • not as much ... as I'd like — xohlaganimchalik emas I don't travel as much as I'd like. • these days — hozirgi kunlarda These days I mostly read on my phone. "Yes, I like." deb to'xtab qolmang — bunday javob juda qisqa. ✍️ Vazifa: "Do you like cooking?" savoliga shu tuzilmada javob yozing va ovoz chiqarib ayting.

Speaking Part 2: "Describe a place you would like to visit" 1 daqiqalik tayyorgarlikda 4 ta kalit so'z yozing: qayer, u haqida qanday bilgansiz, u yerda nima qilasiz, nega. Band 7 namunaning boshlanishi: I'd like to talk about Kyoto, a city in Japan that I've wanted to visit for years. I first learnt about it from a documentary about traditional Japanese architecture. If I went there, I would spend most of my time exploring the old temples and gardens. What really appeals to me is the way the city combines modern life with ancient traditions. Foydali iboralar: • I've wanted to ... for years — ko'p yillardan beri ... xohlayman I've wanted to learn the guitar for years. • What really appeals to me is... — meni eng ko'p o'ziga tortadigan narsa... What really appeals to me is the local food. ✍️ Vazifa: o'zingiz borishni xohlagan joy haqida 2 daqiqa gapiring va telefonga yozib oling.
topic: Speaking Part 2: a place you would like to visit

text: Speaking Part 3: fikrni qanday kengaytirish kerak Savol: Should governments spend more money on public transport? Band 7 namuna javob: I'd say yes, on the whole. Better public transport would reduce the number of cars on the road, which would cut both traffic and air pollution. For example, when a new metro line opens, many people stop driving to work. That said, it's an expensive investment, so the authorities need to make sure the new routes actually meet people's needs. Tuzilma: fikr → sabab → misol → boshqa tomon. • on the whole — umuman olganda On the whole, I enjoyed the course. • That said, — shunday bo'lsa-da The flat is small. That said, it's very cheap. • meet people's needs — odamlar ehtiyojini qondirmoq The new park doesn't really meet local people's needs. ✍️ Vazifa: "Should university education be free?" savoliga shu 4 bosqichli javob tayyorlang.

Writing Task 1: o'zgarishlarni tasvirlash Grafikni tasvirlashda bitta so'zni takrorlamaslik uchun: O'sish: rise, increase, grow The number of tourists rose steadily between 2010 and 2015. Pasayish: fall, decline, drop Sales dropped sharply in March. Barqarorlik: remain stable, level off Prices levelled off at around $50. Eng yuqori nuqta: peak at Unemployment peaked at 12% in 2009. Darajani ko'rsatuvchi so'zlar: slightly (biroz), gradually (asta-sekin), significantly (sezilarli), dramatically (keskin). Fe'l o'rniga ot ham ishlatish mumkin: There was a gradual increase in car sales. ✍️ Vazifa: istalgan grafikni oching va 3 ta gap yozing: o'sish, pasayish va barqarorlik haqida.

Writing Task 2: opinion essay tuzilmasi Savol turi: To what extent do you agree or disagree? Oddiy va ishonchli 4 paragrafli reja: 1. Kirish — savolni o'z so'zlaringiz bilan qayta yozing va fikringizni aniq ayting. I completely agree that... / I partly agree that..., but... 2. 1-asosiy paragraf — birinchi sabab, tushuntirish va misol. The main reason for this is that... — Buning asosiy sababi shundaki... 3. 2-asosiy paragraf — ikkinchi sabab yoki qarshi fikr. Admittedly, ... However, ... — To'g'ri, ... Biroq, ... 4. Xulosa — fikringizni boshqa so'zlar bilan takrorlang. In conclusion, I firmly believe that... Muhim: fikringiz butun insho davomida bir xil bo'lsin. Kirishda "agree", xulosada "disagree" desangiz — bu jiddiy kamchilik. ✍️ Vazifa: "Children should start learning a foreign language at primary school" mavzusida faqat kirish qismini yozing (2–3 gap).

Reading: True, False va Not Given farqi True — gap matndagi ma'lumotga mos keladi. False — gap matnga zid. Not Given — matnda bu haqda ma'lumot yo'q. Matn: The museum opened in 1995 and attracts thousands of visitors every year. • The museum opened in the 1990s. → True • The museum opened in 2005. → False • The museum is the most popular in the city. → Not Given Strategiya: • Kalit so'zlarni belgilang, lekin matnda sinonimlar bo'lishini kuting: attracts visitors = is visited by many people. • O'z bilimingizga emas, faqat matnga tayaning. • all (hammasi), only (faqat), always (doim) kabi so'zlarga e'tibor bering — ular javobni o'zgartirib yuboradi. ✍️ Vazifa: istalgan inglizcha maqoladan 1 ta gap oling va unga True, False, Not Given bo'ladigan 3 ta gap tuzing.

Listening: javobni oldindan taxmin qilish Audio boshlanishidan oldin savollarni o'qib olishga vaqt beriladi. Undan unumli foydalaning. 1. So'z turini aniqlang. Bo'sh joyga ot, fe'l, son yoki sana kerakmi? The meeting will take place on ______. → kun yoki sana. 2. Sinonimlarni o'ylang. cheap (arzon) → audioda inexpensive yoki doesn't cost much bo'lishi mumkin. 3. Tuzoqlarga tayyor bo'ling. Gapiruvchi fikrini o'zgartirishi mumkin: Let's meet on Tuesday... oh, actually, Wednesday is better. → javob: Wednesday. 4. Imloga e'tibor bering. Noto'g'ri yozilgan so'z odatda xato javob hisoblanadi. ✍️ Vazifa: bugun barcha oylar va hafta kunlari nomlarini xatosiz yozib chiqing. Ayniqsa: Wednesday, February, Thursday.

Mini test: to'g'ri predlogni tanlang Writing va Speaking'da predlog xatolari juda ko'p uchraydi. O'zingizni sinab ko'ring: 1. The government should invest ___ education. (in / on) 2. Success often depends ___ hard work. (of / on) 3. Many students are interested ___ studying abroad. (in / about) 4. Smoking is harmful ___ health. (for / to) 5. There has been an increase ___ the price of petrol. (in / of) Avval o'zingiz javob bering, keyin pastga qarang. · · · Javoblar: 1 — in, 2 — on, 3 — in, 4 — to, 5 — in. Eslab qoling: invest in — ...ga sarmoya kiritmoq depend on — ...ga bog'liq bo'lmoq interested in — ...ga qiziqmoq harmful to — ...ga zararli an increase in — ...ning oshishi ✍️ Vazifa: har bir birikma bilan o'zingiz uchun bittadan gap tuzing.

Kun so'zi: detrimental detrimental (sifat) — zararli, salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatadigan. Talaffuz: /ˌdetrɪˈmentl/ Misol: Spending too much time on screens can be detrimental to children's sleep. (Ekran oldida juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazish bolalar uyqusiga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.) Tuzilma: be detrimental to + ot Nega foydali: Writing'da oddiy "bad" o'rniga ishlatsangiz, lug'at boyligingiz ko'rinadi. bad for the environment → detrimental to the environment Qarama-qarshi ma'no: • beneficial — foydali Regular exercise is beneficial to mental health. Diqqat: yangi so'zni har gapda qaytarmang. Bitta inshoda 1–2 marta ishlatish yetarli. ✍️ Vazifa: "detrimental to" va "beneficial to" bilan texnologiya haqida bittadan gap yozing.

Writing Task 2: bog'lovchi so'zlar Fikrlar mantiqiy bog'langan bo'lishi kerak. Asosiy guruhlar: Moreover / Furthermore — bundan tashqari Cycling is cheap. Moreover, it keeps you fit. However / Nevertheless — biroq / shunga qaramay Online learning is flexible. However, it requires strong self-discipline. Therefore / As a result — shuning uchun / natijada Housing is expensive. As a result, many young people live with their parents. For instance — masalan Some jobs can be done remotely, for instance, web design. Ko'p uchraydigan xatolar: • Har bir gapni bog'lovchi bilan boshlash — matn sun'iy ko'rinadi. • "Moreover" dan keyin qarama-qarshi fikr yozish. U faqat qo'shimcha fikr uchun. ✍️ Vazifa: shaharda yashashning afzalliklari haqida 3 gaplik kichik paragraf yozing va 2 xil bog'lovchi ishlating.

Grammatika: who, which, where bilan murakkab gaplar Grammatik xilma-xillik uchun faqat oddiy gaplar yetarli emas. Eng oson yo'l — relative clauses (aniqlovchi ergash gaplar). who — odamlar uchun Teachers who inspire their students are never forgotten. which — narsalar uchun Online courses, which are often cheaper, are becoming popular. where — joylar uchun Tashkent is the city where I grew up. Vergul qoidasi: ergash gap zarur ma'lumot bersa — vergul qo'yilmaydi; qo'shimcha ma'lumot bersa — vergul bilan ajratiladi. Ikki gapni birlashtirish: I have a friend. He works in London. → I have a friend who works in London. ✍️ Vazifa: o'zingiz haqingizda who, which va where bilan bittadan gap tuzing.

Mini test: so'zni to'g'ri shaklga keltiring Qavs ichidagi so'zni gapga mos shaklga o'zgartiring: 1. The ______ of the city has grown rapidly. (populate) 2. Learning a second language is ______ for your career. (benefit) 3. The two results were ______ different. (significant) 4. Many experts have ______ the new law. (critic) 5. Education plays an ______ role in society. (importance) Avval o'zingiz yozing, keyin tekshiring. · · · Javoblar: 1 — population (aholi), 2 — beneficial (foydali), 3 — significantly (sezilarli darajada), 4 — criticised (tanqid qilgan), 5 — important (muhim). Maslahat: yangi so'z o'rganganda uning ot, fe'l, sifat va ravish shakllarini birga yozib oling: benefit → beneficial → beneficially ✍️ Vazifa: "success" so'zining 3 ta shaklini topib, har biri bilan gap tuzing.
